name: anaesthetic
description: This table holds one row for each anaesthetic that the anaesthesia layer has written, with the facts that most questions about an anaesthetic start from.

fields.name: anaesthetic_id
fields.description: The identifier is the procedure_occurrence_id of the anaesthetic's own row in PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE, the row whose procedure_source_value is ANAESTHETIC.

fields.name: person_id
fields.description: The person is the person of the anaesthetic's own procedure row.

fields.name: visit_occurrence_id
fields.description: The hospital visit is the visit of the anaesthetic's own procedure row.

fields.name: visit_detail_id
fields.description: The visit detail is the one that the anaesthetic's own procedure row names, which covers the time under anaesthesia.

fields.name: anaesthesia_type_concept_id
fields.description: The type of anaesthetic is the procedure concept of the anaesthetic's own procedure row, such as 4174669 for a general anaesthetic.

fields.name: start_datetime
fields.description: The start is the procedure_datetime of the anaesthetic's own procedure row.

fields.name: end_datetime
fields.description: The end is the procedure_end_datetime of the anaesthetic's own procedure row, and it is empty where the source records a start and no stop.

fields.name: duration_minutes
fields.description: The duration is the number of minute boundaries from the start to the end, as DATEDIFF(minute, start, end) counts them, and it is empty where the anaesthetic has no end.

fields.name: age_days
fields.description: The age is the number of calendar days from the date of birth in person.birth_datetime to the date of the start, as DATEDIFF(day, birth, start) counts them.

fields.name: age_years
fields.description: The age in years is the number of whole years completed from the date of birth in person.birth_datetime to the date of the start, by calendar date, so that a child is one year old from the date of the first birthday, and a child born on 29 February completes a year on 1 March in a year without that date.

fields.name: age_months
fields.description: The age in months is the number of whole months completed from the date of birth in person.birth_datetime to the date of the start, by calendar date, so that a month is completed on the day of the month of birth, or on the first day of the next month where a month has no such day.

fields.name: asa_class_concept_id
fields.description: The ASA class is the value concept of the ASA measurement (concept 4199571) whose measurement_event_id points at the anaesthetic, taking the earliest where there is more than one.

fields.name: weight_kg
fields.description: The weight is the most recent body weight measurement (concept 3025315, in kilograms) of the person recorded from seven days before the start to the end of the anaesthetic, or to its start where it has no end, and it is empty where none was recorded in that time.

fields.name: provider_id
fields.description: The provider is the provider of the anaesthetic's own procedure row, who is the first member of staff that the source lists for the anaesthetic.

name: anaesthetic_phase
description: This table holds one row for each phase of an anaesthetic, and for now the only phase is the whole anaesthetic, from its start to its end.

fields.name: anaesthetic_phase_id
fields.description: The identifier numbers the phases from 1, in the order of the anaesthetic and then of the phase within it.

fields.name: anaesthetic_id
fields.description: The anaesthetic is the row of the anaesthetic table that the phase belongs to.

fields.name: phase_sequence
fields.description: The sequence numbers the phases of one anaesthetic from 1, and the whole anaesthetic is phase 1.

fields.name: phase_name
fields.description: The name of the phase is taken from a fixed list, which at present holds only whole anaesthetic.

fields.name: start_datetime
fields.description: The start of the phase is set by the phase's rule, and for the whole anaesthetic it is the anaesthetic's start.

fields.name: end_datetime
fields.description: The end of the phase is set by the phase's rule, and for the whole anaesthetic it is the anaesthetic's end, which is empty where the anaesthetic has no recorded stop.

fields.name: phase_rule
fields.description: The rule states in one sentence how the start and the end of the phase were found.

fields.name: phase_rule_version
fields.description: The version of the rule rises by one whenever the rule changes, so that rows made under an earlier rule can be told apart.
